ev.q: Gram Chikitsalay suffers from a case of narrative inertia, where the show thinks through every detail
The glue to bind multiple plots is missing in Gram Chikitsalay
Amol Parashar's earnestness makes one care enough for him to see where his journey takes him
It spoofs the melodrama of the village life Hindi cinema of the 80s was replete with
captures, with sharp detail and humour, the everyday workings of the village
